REVIEW_FAMILY.dependency_scope: All nine assessments are required for family completeness. Their edges below record the assessed source logic, not the discharge of the source's geometric hypotheses.

SCOPE_KNOWN.statement: Versioned primary sources supply known dressed-minuscule generation for arbitrary quivers and a symmetric-quiver/enough-loops zonotopal connection, not an originality certificate for the exact cut-symbol filtration. The old search was bounded, the active Wiki index has no matching entry, and the retired cut routes were superseded rather than refuted.

REVIEW_CUT_ABSTRACT.statement: For the explicit unshifted free-module invariant algebra over any commutative Q-algebra in CTX_REVIEW_044, the all-data dressed cut-symbol surjections, internal coefficient generation, finite exhaustion and nonnegative shifts of old C_CUT_ABSTRACT@2 are supported by the prose proof. The BFN application C_CUT_SYMBOL@4 still requires INPUT_LAURENT. This is a human assessment, not new kernel evidence or independent acceptance.
REVIEW_CUT_ABSTRACT.dependency_scope: The independently defined abstract algebra does not depend on BFN geometry. Conditional BFN applications are assessed separately by REVIEW_BFN; the final sentence of the claim distinguishes the Engineer assessment from its later native acceptance.

REVIEW_CUT_CORE.statement: The archived C_CUT_CORE@2 Lean proof covers only universal positive-part excesses under the displayed disjointness hypotheses, orientation signs, finite sums/products, and finite-support cardinality. Matching historical compilation is not a formal proof of generation, trace cosets, Reynolds averaging or BFN geometry.
REVIEW_CUT_CORE.evidence_scope: A human scope assessment of historical compiler evidence. The archived certificate belongs to C_CUT_CORE, not this active review claim; it is not used as mechanical evidence here. This is part of the same cut-symbol unit, not a tenth unit.

REVIEW_BFN.statement: The generation and coefficient-quotient implications of C_MINUSCULE@1-2 and C_COEFF_SURJ@1 are supported within their exact scope; the source proof of C_LAURENT@1 is conditional on the coefficient-, charge- and grading-compatible BFN minuscule/localization interface and is not certified by abstract generation.

REVIEW_KERNEL.statement: The source argument for C_KERNEL@1 coherently gives ker(R to B_F) contained in ker(R to H_F^*(X)), hence a specified coefficient-compatible surjection, provided the stated BFN, finite correspondence, equivariant sheaf and Kirwan interfaces hold. No reverse inclusion or dimension equality follows from this unit.
REVIEW_KERNEL.dependency_scope: The source uses minuscule generation and finite correspondence factorization, not a direct invocation of the polynomial Hall-map lemma. There is intentionally no REVIEW_HALL edge.

REVIEW_COUNTING.statement: The invariant reachability recurrence and its formal-series substitution into the ordinary Hausel formula in C_COUNTING@1 are supported under the stated equivariant Thom/Gysin and determinant moment-level comparison inputs, without replacing the cut ideal by its radical. This is distinct from the symbol-surjection theorem.

REVIEW_LOOP.statement: For C_LOOP_CASE@1, the specified graded coefficient-compatible surjection together with the cut-symbol upper bound and equal counting polynomial implies an isomorphism degree by degree. This is a conditional assembly, not independent evidence for its geometric inputs.
REVIEW_LOOP.dependency_scope: The cut bound is used geometrically only with the separately conditional BFN/Laurent interface. The arithmetic core is not an independent proof of this assembly.

REVIEW_FLAVOR.statement: For C_DEFORM@1 and C_FULL_TORUS@1, the free-target flavor kernel argument, Weyl-norm unit calculation and homogeneous ideal descent are supported; the resulting full-torus comparison remains conditional on the stated BFN base-change, prequotient localization, stability and moment-map interfaces.

REVIEW_HALL.statement: For C_POLY_MAPS@1, the retrieved polynomial Hall-generation and trigonometric operator theorems support the inputs, but the general repeated-slot filtered degeneration, lift independence and full loop/sign comparison are not independently established by the old artifacts. Parameter regularity is distinct from absence of gauge-root denominators.

REVIEW_COCHAR.statement: For C_ROOT_CHARGE@1, C_ROOT_MOMENT@1 and C_COCHAR@1, the source root-support, moment-block and complementary-monopole argument is coherent conditional on the polynomial Hall bridge, BFN conventions and moment-map interfaces. The block needs a scalar stabilizer subgroup, not an exactly scalar stabilizer. Its conclusion concerns actual fixed-scheme ideals, including dimension-hyperplane characters.

REVIEW_HIKITA.statement: C_HIKITA@1 follows formally and coefficientwise from the full-torus comparison and equality of cocharacter/full-charge ideals if all upstream interfaces hold with the same gradings. The local cut certificate alone does not independently establish the full theorem or the entire manuscript.
REVIEW_HIKITA.dependency_scope: These are the two direct source comparisons. The other six upstream units occur through their transitive dependencies; accepting this conditional assembly does not establish any open geometric interface.

REVIEW_ASSOCIATION_CORRECTION.statement: Only the active judgment misbinding a historical C_CUT_CORE certificate to the distinct review claim REVIEW_CUT_CORE was reversibly quarantined. Its original contents and restoration provenance remain preserved, and all mathematical conclusions are unchanged. The native Reviewer approved this specific correction, not project completion.
REVIEW_ASSOCIATION_CORRECTION.evidence_scope: The archive's pending flags record its creation state; the cited later native handoff contains the independent approval. No historical certificate, ledger, source or fidelity text is modified or recompiled.
